title: SIGIL diff v1
description: Schema for the comparison of two SIGIL analysis sessions (`schema: "sigil-diff/1"`), as `sigil compare` writes it. Self-contained: no external $ref. Strict: additionalProperties: false on every object. Enums are externally tagged with their variant names; struct fields are snake_case; every field is always serialized and required. Definitions shared with the session schema are copied from session-v1.schema.json, and ReleaseBasisKind from aibom-v2.schema.json; crates/sigil-model/tests/diff_schema.rs keeps them equal.

Diff.description: What changed between two sessions (sigil-diff/1), as sigil compare writes it. changes are in canonical order: by kind, in the order of Change's variants, then by their JSON text. not_comparable lists the differences that could not be judged, because a check was not closed on the side an item is absent from. evaluation is how the diff was judged under a compare policy (the [compare] section of sigil-policy/1); a reader re-judges it, and a recorded verdict or completeness that the evaluation does not give does not load.

DiffSide.description: One compared session. sha256 is the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON; a session SIGIL saved hashes to its file. completeness is the session's own outcome.completeness, as recorded; an incomplete input makes the diff incomplete.

Change.description: One difference, with the IDs of its item in the session(s) that hold it.

Placement.description: Where a file was found, as a key that survives a new run: the root-relative instance ID under models, install or service-unit; the recorded path under any other root; or content no instance read.

SubjectKey.description: What a finding or policy violation is about, with run-dependent IDs replaced by keys.

Item.description: An item whose difference could not be judged.

NotComparable.description: A difference that could not be judged, and why. For Coverage, checks are the ones that would have to be closed on open_in; for Request, open_in is the side that did not ask for the item and checks holds the one check the request bears on; for Policy, checks is empty and open_in is Both.

Cause.description: Why a difference could not be judged: Coverage (a check is open on open_in), Request (the two runs asked for different things) or Policy (the two sessions applied different policies).

LicenseState.description: What a session recorded of a model's license, with model_store.license closed.

CheckState.description: One check of one session: whether it is required, and its entries by coverage state. No entries: open.

ArtifactId.description: Content identity: sha256 of the whole file. Never a path.

CheckId.description: An audit check whose coverage decides completeness.

ComponentKey.description: A component name used by identification.

ModelId.description: A model in a model store: model:<root id>/<manifest path under manifests/>.

PolicyRuleRef.description: The policy rule a decision came from.

ProbeId.description: An active probe: probe:api/<address>:<port>, with an IPv6 address in brackets.

ProcessRole.description: A process role from a topology rule. Generic: no runtime-specific meaning.

RootId.description: A scan root declared in the request.

RuleId.description: A detection rule that yields findings or open questions.

SliceId.description: One architecture slice of an artifact: <artifact>#<arch>@<offset>.

UntrustedText.description: Input-derived text. A string when valid UTF-8; otherwise {"hex": <lowercase hex of the bytes>}, used only for values that are not valid UTF-8. Consumers must escape it before display.

Evaluation.description: How a diff was judged (#16, PR-16b): the compare policy (its knowledge entry, as a session records its policy), the action of every change kind and the treatment of every cause after the policy's entries, and the result. A change weighs its kind's action; for Decided, the maximum action of its decisions, the current session's (Fail when it has none); a FindingDecisionChanged or ViolationDecisionChanged weighs that action, at least Warn, only when it is heavier than the baseline's maximum (by the same rule), and Warn otherwise; a VerdictChanged weighs the current verdict when it is worse than the baseline's (Fail or Warn), and nothing otherwise. An open question's decision weighs its treatment: Fail and Warn as those actions, CountAsGap and Ignore as nothing; OpenQuestionNew and OpenQuestionTreatmentChanged follow FindingNew and FindingDecisionChanged. verdict is the maximum of the changes' weights and of the items not comparable treated Warn or Fail, Pass without any. completeness is Incomplete when an input is incomplete or an item not comparable is treated CountAsGap.

ChangeTreatment.description: The action of one change kind, its source, and the policy's reason. The source is default:compare.<Kind> (the default action, and no reason) or policy:compare.changes.<Kind>; the policy's Ignore needs a reason that is not blank (the schema checks for a character other than a space, a tab or a line break; a reader checks the rest, and the source).

NotComparableTreatment.description: The treatment of the items not comparable for one cause: CountAsGap makes the diff Incomplete, Warn and Fail count toward the verdict, Ignore toward neither. The source is default:compare.not_comparable.<Cause> (the default treatment, and no reason) or policy:compare.not_comparable.<Cause>; the policy's Ignore needs a reason that is not blank (the schema checks for a character other than a space, a tab or a line break; a reader checks the rest, and the source).

CompareAction.description: What the changes of one kind weigh. Decided: what the change's own decisions (the current session's) say; a changed decision weighs that only when it got heavier, at least Warn, and Warn otherwise; a changed verdict weighs the current verdict when it is worse than the baseline's, and nothing otherwise; an open question's decision weighs its treatment (Fail and Warn as those actions, CountAsGap and Ignore as nothing) by the same rules; VerdictChanged, FindingNew, FindingDecisionChanged, ViolationNew, ViolationDecisionChanged, OpenQuestionNew, and OpenQuestionTreatmentChanged only.

DiffCompleteness.description: Whether the comparison saw everything it judged. Incomplete names the inputs that are incomplete themselves (null when both are complete) and counts the items not comparable treated CountAsGap; at least one of the two holds.
